samples.detection_method: Monitor Azure Activity Logs for anonymous blob read operations, audit storage account and container public access settings, leverage Azure Security Center recommendations and policies to detect publicly accessible storage containers, and correlate access logs with IP reputation and unusual access volumes.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.detection_method: Analyze GCP audit logs for storage.objects.get calls by allUsers or anonymous principals, review bucket IAM policies for overly permissive roles assigned to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers, use Google Cloud Security Command Center to detect public buckets and correlate access logs with external IPs and unusual access patterns.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.detection_method: Analyze Azure Storage logs and Azure Monitor activity logs for anonymous blob read operations. Use Azure Security Center to identify storage accounts with public access enabled. Implement storage account firewall rules and enable soft delete for blobs. Scan for confidential file extensions and metadata to prioritize alerts.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
